title: Coolant Temperature Sensor High Error
detail_of_failure: A high voltage occurs in the signal circuit of the engine coolant temperature sensor.
controller_action: Sets the coolant temperature to a fixed value, and runs the engine.
machine_effect: • The engine startability is degraded at low temperatures. • The overheat prevention function does not operate.
related_information: k Because hot water can blow out of the coolant temperature sensor installation part even if the radiator cap is removed when you test and replace the coolant temperature sensor, drain coolant by 10ℓ. • The input voltage from the engine coolant temperature sensor can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 04105 (V)) • The temperature sensed by the engine coolant temperature sensor can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 04107 (℃)) • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Turn the starting switch to the ON position. • When the temperature sensor connector is disconnected, this failure code is shown. • The connector of “socket” for troubleshooting for this sensor is female only. So the socket cannot be connected to the female connector on the wiring harness side of the sensor, and check for wire breakage cannot be done (T-adapter is not provided).

steps.procedure: Check the wiring harness and connector. For details, see “Related Information to Troubleshooting”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”.

1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector COOLANT TEMP. Connect the socket to the male side. REMARK When the coolant temperature is 0℃ or above, if the resistance of the coolant temperature sensor is 700Ω to 37kΩ, the coolant temperature sensor is regarded as correct.

measurements.point: Between COOLANT TEMP (male) (A) and (B) (thermal characteristics of coolant temperature sensor) / 0℃

steps.cause: Open or short circuit in wiring harness
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector ECM. Connect a T-adapter to the female side.
